description: Sample time, UTC. 1 s grid in the full tier, 10 s in the starter tier; rows are absent during gateway outages.
PLC operating state of the pump drive (from the motor starter / drive status, not from the fault model).
Motor speed reported by the variable-speed drive. NULL for fixed-speed (DOL) assets.
Motor line current (RMS). Includes start-up inrush on direct-on-line assets.
Electrical input power (drive or power meter). NULL where no power measurement exists.
Pump suction pressure, gauge. NULL on assets without a suction transmitter.
Volumetric flow. NULL on assets without a flow meter.
Pump drive-end bearing housing temperature. Sparse (every 300 s) on wireless retrofit sensors.
Motor stator winding temperature (PT100). Fully instrumented assets only.
Overall vibration velocity RMS, 10-1000 Hz, pump bearing housing, radial.
Overall acceleration RMS (high-frequency band) from the same sensor.
Crest factor (peak/RMS) of the acceleration signal.
Machinery-space / pump-room air temperature (10 s update).
Control-valve position feedback (process / pressure-controlled loops only).
1 COMM_LOSS, 2 OUT_OF_RANGE, 4 STALE, 8 BAD_SENSOR_STATUS, 16 STARTUP_INHIBIT (4 and 8 reserved, not set in this release).
Data sources present on the asset (PLC, VFD, WIRELESS, IOLINK, POWER_METER, FLOW_METER), separated by a pipe character.
Nominal sampling interval of the row grid: 1 (full tier) or 10 (starter tier).
Benchmark split. Test labels are not public.
First timestamp of the asset's data window.
Head at zero flow, rated speed.
NPSH3 (3 % head drop) at BEP flow, rated speed.
Static head of the system curve (0 for closed loops).
Pump drive-end bearing (deep-groove ball bearing series).
Outer-race defect frequency order (computed from bearing geometry).
Number of impeller vanes (vane-pass frequency = vanes x running speed).
Telemetry columns that carry data for this asset, separated by a pipe character.
Update interval of battery wireless sensors (T1).
Physical onset (clipped to window start for pre-existing conditions).
Condition already present at window start.
First time the effect exceeds 3 sigma of sensor noise on an instrumented channel (10-min mean). NULL = not observable with this asset's instrumentation.
First time a conventional limit is reached while the fault is active (vibration alarm, cooling-flow shortfall, NPSH margin < 1.1). NULL if never reached in the window.
Repair / resolution time. NULL = persists past window end.
Instrumented channels that carried the earliest evidence, in order.
Whether the event is detectable with the asset's instruments (unobservable events are not scored).
Causing event for compound incidents. Process events that are not scored are written as TYPE:ID (PLANNED_MAINTENANCE:..., SUCTION_LEVEL_DROP:...); OPERATING_CONDITION when no fault caused it.
Affected telemetry column for instrument faults (GATEWAY for communication loss).
MEDIUM when the end time is not observed in the window or the episode is emergent.
Alarmed telemetry column, INSTRUMENT or GATEWAY.
Operator acknowledgement (NULL = not acknowledged in time).
Free-text observation as recorded (may contain a wrong suspicion).
Schedule / voyage state from the vessel or plant system (sea passage, port, production, batch, ...).
Heat-load / duty demand signal from the plant system.
Inlet water temperature reported by the plant system (seawater, tower basin, LT loop or process tank).
Sea temperature at the sea chest (vessels only).
Space ambient temperature from the building / vessel automation.
Significant wave height from the vessel's weather routing (vessels only).
Suction level / submergence where a level transmitter exists.
